title: job event: file
description: A piece of a file a vendor tool wrote on the bench host (tool-run only, clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:2610-2643). Files are cut into 512 KiB pieces before base64; an empty file is one frame with b64 "" and end true. Not in the hub JobEvent enum (known-gaps G4); the hub reads it by string literal (src/alb/remote/flash.py:979-991).

name.description: File name relative to the tool's working directory.

size.description: Total length of the file in bytes.

offset.description: Byte offset of this piece in the file.

b64.description: This piece, standard base64 with padding.

end.description: True on the last piece of this file.
